limits: Saved beam strings are rescored but beam search is not rerun.
Raw gradients and optimizer states were not saved; telemetry is hash-checked and internally cross-checked.
Cache hashes and transform indices are checked; pixel_changed_frame_count is range-checked, not recomputed.

settings.sampler: epoch-full-index-shuffle-v1; differs from prior fixed length-pair sampler

scope.A_additional48: not trained in A; diagnostic subset of existing train split
scope.B_additional48: trained in B; not a held-out evaluation set

cohorts.selection: short16=(frames,id) ascending; candidate train-only speaker x50-frame cells; sorted cells shuffled once by local seed; SHA256 within cell; round-robin48

metric_definitions.gradient_timing: caller invokes after AMP unscale before clipping, and again after clipping; helper never unscales or clips
metric_definitions.l2_norm: sqrt(sum of squares over all present gradient elements); null if any element is nonfinite
metric_definitions.finite_l2_norm: norm of only finite elements, for diagnostics; not a substitute for l2_norm when nonfinite elements exist
metric_definitions.missing_grad_tensors: trainable parameter tensors whose grad is None; distinct from zero gradients
metric_definitions.zero_grad_tensors: present gradient tensors with all elements exactly zero
metric_definitions.zero_grad_elements: elements exactly zero among present gradients; missing elements are excluded
metric_definitions.nonfinite_grad_elements: NaN or positive/negative infinity among present gradient elements
metric_definitions.parameter_update_absolute_l2: norm of actual parameters after minus snapshot before the attempted optimizer step
metric_definitions.parameter_update_relative_l2: absolute L2 update / max(before parameter L2 norm,1e-12); null when inputs are nonfinite
metric_definitions.schedule: one shuffled permutation of every branch sample per epoch, contiguous full batches; independent local Python RNG
metric_definitions.exposures: planned sample presentations per attempted update; not successful AMP optimizer updates

first_observed_short16_greedy_exact_belo.note: No sampled normal snapshot below16; changes between snapshots are unobserved.
First sampled snapshot below16; the exact onset between snapshots is unknown. Not early stopping.

interpretation: All64 clips belong to the existing train split. A's additional48 is untrained in A but is not an external validation set; B trains on it.
Both branches restart from the same inference weights with fresh Adam/GradScaler; optimizer state is not resumed.
Equal1600 attempted batches are unequal per-ID exposures: A200 and B50; successful exposures exclude AMP-skipped batches.
The branches also differ in clip lengths, text and speakers; this experiment does not isolate the causal effect of dataset size.
Cohorts16/48 and conditions are separate; common step0 is stored once, never treated as extra independent observations.
CER/WER values are ratios, not percentages. Sentence means and pooled edit-count rates have different denominators.
Token top4 is pooled over raw collapsed greedy token IDs; beam NFD length is decoded text length, not a hidden beam token path.
clip_invoked_count follows runner clip_applied; effective_clipping_count requires coefficient<1. Null nonfinite norms are not zeros.
Static/shuffle response measures sensitivity, not correct recognition; no generalization or deployment claim is supported.
